steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ with username admin and password bench-admin-pass. After signing in, go to the Opportunities list and find every opportunity whose name starts with 'Seed:'. Report the full names of those opportunities exactly as shown on screen, one per line.

02-create: Create a new Opportunity in EspoCRM with these exact values: Name = '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'; Account = the account named 'Bench Account' (it is a link field — you must actually select the record 'Bench Account' from the suggestions or select dialog, not just type text; other accounts have similar names so pick the exact one); Description = 'Bench opportunity created for run {{runid}}'; Stage = 'Negotiation'; Amount = 12500; Close Date = 2026-12-31; Assigned to the user named 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — actually select the user record 'Bench Assignee', other users have similar names). Save the record. Then open the saved record's own page and report: the name shown, the account shown, the stage, the amount, the close date, the assigned user, and the record ID from the page address (the part after #Opportunity/view/).

03-find: On the opportunity record page at {{02-create.url}} (the one named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'), find the Stream panel and post a new message with the text: 'Bench stream post for run {{runid}}'. Submit the post. Then verify the post appears in the Stream panel on that record page and report the exact text of the post as displayed.

04-change: Verification task, read-only (do not change anything). Two parts: (1) Open the Opportunities list view and report the full names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed. (2) Open the opportunity record page at {{02-create.url}} and report exactly what the page shows for: Name, Account, Stage, Amount, Close Date, Assigned User, and the text of the most recent post in the Stream panel. Also confirm the page address contains the record ID.
